extension.news: 1.0.0: first release. Poster-grid library pages, Plex-style home pages with real scrolling rows, dimmed backdrop art, clock and greeting, Rotten Tomatoes audience score, film page opens on the play button.
extension.summary: A TV-first skin with poster grids and rows you can scroll in every direction.
extension.description: xelp is a skin for living-room Kodi, built for a TV and a controller. Library pages are poster grids; the home pages are stacks of real rows (Continue Watching, Recently Added, Recommended and more) that scroll in every direction, with the selected title's art dimmed behind them.[CR][CR]It is a fork of the fTV skin by Hitcher, with a rebuilt home, a new grid view, and many small fixes.[CR][CR]Uses: Global Search, Up Next, TMDb Helper, Trakt, Special Features.
extension.disclaimer: Made for a TV with a remote or game controller. Does not support mouse, touch, or Live TV. Press the context-menu button (X on an Xbox pad) on a row item for options such as removing it from Continue Watching. Tested on Kodi 21 (Omega) on Linux.
